To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The evolution of proto-language can be modelled using a memetic approach; (2) A small set of alarm call memes can evolve in a population of agents that are able to communicate via memes; (3) The evolution of a proto-language is dependent upon a number of factors, such as the frequency of the memes and the fitness of the agents.
the process of memetic evolution is a powerful and parsimonious way for agents to communicate in a complex environment.

the evolution of language, and in particular the evolution of the meaning of words, or more precisely the evolution of the association between words and the contexts in which they are used.
the evolution of proto-language and the emergence of simple ‘words’.

the results of the simulation show that memetic reproduction can be a viable mechanism for the evolution of proto-language.

the evolution of language can be explained as a memetic evolution process.

a simple model of memetic evolution can produce a simple language with a small number of words that are used in specific contexts.
